2609.02133.title: EmoStance: Response-Side Affective-Orientation Control for Empathetic Response Generation via Emoji Weak Supervision
2609.02133.paper_summary: Empathetic response generation requires models to decide not only what to say, but also how to respond to the previous speaker's affective situation. We formulate this as response-side affective-orientation control and use multi-annotator emoji distributions as weak affective--attitudinal evidence, rather than as output symbols or gold labels, to induce a latent control space that operationally approximates listener stance. We construct EmojiDialogue, an utterance-level extension of EmpatheticDialogues with emoji votes and confidence scores, and propose EmoStance, which models source-side affective expression, predicts a soft response-side orientation from dialogue context and speaker roles, and steers a frozen instruction-tuned LLM through continuous prefix embeddings. In blind pairwise evaluation with 20 annotators and 800 judgments, EmoStance achieves a 62.2% decisive win rate, with the clearest gains in contextual specificity and perceived responsiveness, while remaining complementary to external-knowledge methods. Code, annotation metadata, and reconstruction scripts are available in our GitHub repository: https://github.com/18277390221/EmoStance.
2609.02133.paper_summary_zh: 同理心反應生成需要模型不僅決定要說什麼，還要如何回應前一位講者的情感狀況。我們將此表述為反應側情感導向控制，並使用多標註者的表情符號分佈作為弱情感--態度證據，而不是作為輸出符號或金標籤，以誘導一個潛在的控制空間，該空間在操作上近似於聽者的立場。我們構建了EmojiDialogue，這是一個包含表情符號投票和信心分數的同理心對話的發言級擴展，並提出EmoStance，該模型從源側情感表達中預測對話上下文和講者角色的軟反應側導向，並通過連續前綴嵌入引導一個凍結的指令調整大型語言模型。在與20位標註者和800次評判的盲對比評估中，EmoStance實現了62.2%的決定性勝率，在上下文特異性和感知響應性方面獲得了最明顯的提升，同時仍然與外部知識方法互補。代碼、標註元數據和重建腳本可在我們的GitHub倉庫中獲得：https://github.com/18277390221/EmoStance。
